ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Key Manager Access
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the invocation of the Stored User Names and Passwords dialogue (Key Manager)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*keymgr.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*KRShowKeyMgr.*")))
